mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reply (member_id, post_id, content) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{postId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.member_id, m.nickname, m.profile_image, r.post_id, r.content, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM reply r JOIN member m ON r.member_id = m.id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.member_id, m.nickname, m.profile_image, r.post_id, r.content, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM reply r JOIN member m ON r.member_id = m.id WHERE r.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY r. created_at ASC
